senses.en: not curved or bent
directly, without turning or stopping
honest and clear rather than hiding the truth

ex.en: Use a ruler to draw a straight line.
ex.zh: 用尺子画一条直线。

ex.en: Building straight roads across mountainous regions can be expensive and may damage natural habitats.
ex.zh: 在山区修建笔直的道路可能成本高昂，还可能破坏自然栖息地。

col: a straight answer｜直截了当的回答
tip: straight本身可作副词，不用加-ly。

senses.en: A casual shirt, usually with short sleeves and no collar.

ex.en: I packed a clean T-shirt for the picnic.
ex.zh: 我为野餐带了一件干净的T恤衫。

ex.en: Choosing a durable cotton T-shirt instead of disposable fashion can reduce waste and encourage more responsible consumption.
ex.zh: 选择耐穿的棉质T恤衫而非一次性时尚服饰，可以减少浪费并促进更负责任的消费。

tip: 可数名词，复数为 T-shirts，保留连字符。

senses.en: Trousers made from strong cotton cloth, usually denim.

ex.en: These jeans are still wet from the wash.
ex.zh: 这条牛仔裤洗后还没干。

ex.en: Allowing employees to wear jeans may create a more relaxed workplace without necessarily reducing professional standards.
ex.zh: 允许员工穿牛仔裤可能营造更轻松的工作环境，而不一定降低职业标准。

col: a pair of jeans｜一条牛仔裤
tip: jeans用复数；一条用a pair of jeans。

senses.en: How big or small someone or something is.
A standard measurement used for clothes and other products.
To sort by measurements or make something a particular size.

ex.en: This suitcase is just the right size for weekends.
ex.zh: 这个行李箱的大小正适合周末出行。

ex.en: Reducing class size may allow teachers to provide more individual support to students with learning difficulties.
ex.zh: 缩小班级规模或许能让教师为有学习困难的学生提供更多个别辅导。

tip: 问尺码用What size，不用How much size。

senses.en: the outer form of something
to influence how something develops
to give something a particular physical form

ex.en: She cut the biscuits into the shape of stars.
ex.zh: 她把饼干坯切成了星星的形状。

ex.en: Early childhood experiences can shape attitudes towards learning and influence future educational achievement.
ex.zh: 幼年经历可以塑造学习态度，并影响未来的学业成就。

col: stay in shape｜保持良好的身体状态
tip: in shape可指身体状态好，不只表示形状。

senses.en: The natural outer covering of a person's or animal's body.
The thin outer layer of certain fruits and vegetables.
Remove the skin from an animal, fruit or vegetable.

ex.en: My skin feels dry after swimming in the pool.
ex.zh: 在泳池游泳后，我觉得皮肤很干。

ex.en: Protecting skin from excessive sunlight can reduce the risk of serious health problems later in life.
ex.zh: 保护皮肤免受过度日晒，可以降低日后出现严重健康问题的风险。

tip: 指人体皮肤通常不可数；一张兽皮可数。

senses.en: Different from usual, often in an important or valued way.
Intended for a particular purpose or person.
A specially priced product or a featured restaurant dish.

ex.en: We saved this special cake for your birthday.
ex.zh: 我们把这个特别的蛋糕留到了你生日时享用。

ex.en: Schools should provide special equipment so that students with disabilities can participate fully in classroom activities.
ex.zh: 学校应提供专用设备，让残障学生能够充分参与课堂活动。

tip: specially强调专门；especially常表示尤其。

senses.en: a value used for counting, measuring, or identifying something
the total amount of people or things
to assign identifying figures or add up to a total

ex.en: I saved your phone number on my new phone.
ex.zh: 我把你的电话号码存到了新手机里。

ex.en: The number of people working from home has increased as digital communication tools have improved.
ex.zh: 随着数字通信工具的改进，居家办公的人数有所增加。

tip: a number of接复数谓语；the number of接单数谓语。

senses.en: used to introduce the second thing in a comparison
used before a clause expressing the other side of a comparison

ex.en: My new backpack is lighter than my old one.
ex.zh: 我的新背包比旧的轻。

ex.en: Investing in public transport may be more effective than building additional roads in crowded cities.
ex.zh: 在拥挤的城市，投资公共交通可能比增建道路更有效。

tip: than用于比较；then表示“然后”，注意拼写。

senses.en: light-coloured or pale, especially used to describe hair or skin

ex.en: My new classmate from England has bright blue eyes and fair hair.
ex.zh: 我来自英国的新同学有着明亮的蓝眼睛和浅色的头发。

ex.en: In our storybook, the gentle princess has fair skin, golden hair, and a warm smile.
ex.zh: 在我们的故事书里，那位温柔的公主有着白皙的皮肤、金色的头发和温暖的微笑。

col: have fair hair｜留着浅色头发
tip: 本课用来形容外貌，指头发或皮肤“浅色的；白皙的”，反义词是 dark。

senses.en: A natural ability to do something well.
People who have strong abilities in a particular field.

ex.en: My cousin has a real talent for drawing animals.
ex.zh: 我的表亲画动物很有天赋。

ex.en: Schools should nurture creative talent alongside academic skills to help students develop a wider range of abilities.
ex.zh: 学校应在培养学业技能的同时培育创造性才能，帮助学生发展更广泛的能力。

col: a talent for｜在某方面的天赋
tip: 表示某方面的天赋，用a talent for加名词或动名词。

senses.zh: 节目单；计划；方案；活动安排

senses.en: an organised set of activities with a particular purpose
a show broadcast on television or radio
to arrange activities or set a machine to operate automatically

ex.en: I joined a fitness programme at the local gym.
ex.zh: 我参加了当地健身房的一项健身计划。

ex.en: A well-designed training programme can help unemployed adults gain the skills needed for new careers.
ex.zh: 设计合理的培训项目能帮助失业成年人掌握新职业所需的技能。

col: launch a programme｜启动一项计划
tip: 英式通常用programme，计算机程序用program；美式均用program。

senses.en: a large room in a school or public building for meetings and events

ex.en: All the students sit quietly in the school hall on Monday morning.
ex.zh: 周一早上，所有学生都安静地坐在学校礼堂里。

ex.en: Our choir will perform two cheerful English songs in the music hall this Friday evening.
ex.zh: 我们合唱团本周五晚上将在音乐大厅表演两首欢快的英文歌曲。

tip: 注意不要和 tall（高的）混淆，hall 表示宽敞的“礼堂；大厅”。

senses.en: An insect with broad, often colourful wings and a thin body.
A swimming stroke with both arms moving forward together above water.

ex.en: A yellow butterfly landed gently on my sleeve.
ex.zh: 一只黄色蝴蝶轻轻落在我的袖子上。

ex.en: Planting native flowers in urban gardens can support butterfly populations and contribute to greater local biodiversity.
ex.zh: 在城市花园中种植本地花卉可以帮助维持蝴蝶种群，并提升当地的生物多样性。

tip: 复数为butterflies；蝶泳义通常不可数。

senses.en: A four-stringed instrument held under the chin and usually bowed.

ex.en: My sister practises the violin after dinner every evening.
ex.zh: 我姐姐每天晚饭后都练习小提琴。

ex.en: Learning the violin can help children develop concentration, although regular lessons may be expensive for some families.
ex.zh: 学习小提琴有助于儿童培养专注力，但定期上课对某些家庭来说可能费用较高。

col: a violin concerto｜小提琴协奏曲
tip: 小提琴手是violinist；拉小提琴常说play the violin。

senses.en: a person who introduces guests and leads a TV, radio, or stage show

ex.en: The cheerful host welcomed everyone at the start of the TV show.
ex.zh: 在电视节目开始时，开朗的节目主持人欢迎了所有人。

ex.en: At our school art festival, Amy worked as the stage host and introduced each act.
ex.zh: 在学校艺术节上，艾米担任舞台节目主持人并介绍了每一个节目。

tip: 本课指电视、广播或晚会的“节目主持人”，女性主持人也可称 hostess。

senses.en: something you hear
to seem a certain way when heard, or produce noise
sensible, reliable, or in good condition

ex.en: The sound of rain woke me before sunrise.
ex.zh: 天还没亮，雨声就把我吵醒了。

ex.en: Environmental policies should be based on sound scientific evidence rather than assumptions about public behaviour.
ex.zh: 环境政策应以可靠的科学证据为基础，而非对公众行为的假设。

tip: sound后接形容词；sound like后接名词。

senses.en: to make someone feel enthusiastic and eager
to cause a particular feeling or reaction

ex.en: Trips to the seaside always excite my younger sister.
ex.zh: 去海边玩总能让我妹妹兴奋不已。

ex.en: Interactive science exhibitions can excite young visitors and encourage them to explore scientific ideas independently.
ex.zh: 互动式科学展览能让年轻参观者兴奋起来，并鼓励他们自主探索科学概念。

tip: 人感到兴奋用excited；事物令人兴奋用exciting。

senses.zh: 令人兴奋的；令人激动的

senses.en: Making someone feel eager, enthusiastic, or thrilled.

ex.en: The final minutes of the match were incredibly exciting.
ex.zh: 比赛最后几分钟精彩刺激极了。

ex.en: Advances in renewable energy offer exciting opportunities for young engineers seeking to address global environmental challenges.
ex.zh: 可再生能源的进步为希望应对全球环境挑战的年轻工程师提供了令人振奋的机会。

tip: exciting形容令人兴奋的事物；excited形容人的感受。

senses.en: Any thing at all, without limits on choice
Something, used especially in questions and conditional statements

ex.en: You can choose anything from this basket of toys.
ex.zh: 你可以从这篮玩具里随便挑一件。

ex.en: Before introducing new policies, governments should check whether anything similar has worked successfully elsewhere.
ex.zh: 在推行新政策之前，政府应查明其他地方是否有类似的成功做法。

tip: 疑问句中常指“什么”；陈述句中可指“任何事物”。

senses.en: a person whose identity is unknown or not stated

ex.en: Someone left a blue umbrella beside the front door.
ex.zh: 有人把一把蓝色雨伞落在了前门旁边。

ex.en: Students may feel more confident seeking help when someone they trust is available to discuss their concerns.
ex.zh: 如果有信任的人可以倾听他们的困扰，学生求助时可能会更有信心。

col: someone to talk to｜可以倾诉的人
tip: 作主语时谓语用单数；后文可用they指代。

senses.en: a person whose identity is unknown or not stated

ex.en: Somebody left a blue umbrella beside the front door.
ex.zh: 有人把一把蓝色雨伞落在了前门旁边。

ex.en: Students are more likely to seek help when they know somebody will listen without judging them.
ex.zh: 如果学生知道有人会倾听而不评判他们，就更有可能寻求帮助。

col: somebody to talk to｜可以倾诉的人
tip: 作主语时谓语用单数；回指常用they。

senses.en: a musical instrument played by hitting its stretched surface
a large cylindrical container for storing liquids or other materials
to play a drum or tap something repeatedly

ex.en: The little boy beat the drum with both hands.
ex.zh: 小男孩用双手敲鼓。

ex.en: Learning to play the drum can help children develop coordination and participate in group performances.
ex.zh: 学习打鼓能帮助儿童培养协调能力，并参与集体表演。

tip: play the drums常指打鼓；drum也可指大圆桶。

senses.en: The sound someone makes when speaking or singing.
The right or opportunity to express opinions and influence decisions.
To express an opinion, feeling, or concern.

ex.en: Her gentle voice helped the frightened puppy settle down.
ex.zh: 她温柔的声音让受惊的小狗安静了下来。

ex.en: Public consultations give local residents a voice in decisions that directly affect their communities.
ex.zh: 公众咨询让当地居民有机会参与直接影响其社区的决策。

col: a voice in decisions｜决策中的发言权
tip: voice侧重人的嗓音；sound泛指声音。

senses.en: an individual human being
a grammatical category distinguishing speakers, listeners, and others

ex.en: Only one person was waiting outside the bakery.
ex.zh: 只有一个人在面包店外等候。

ex.en: Every person should have access to affordable healthcare, regardless of income or employment status.
ex.zh: 每个人都应享有负担得起的医疗服务，无论其收入或就业状况如何。

tip: 普通复数用people；persons多见于正式法律语境。

senses.en: An activity you regularly do for pleasure in your free time

ex.en: Growing herbs on my balcony has become my favourite hobby.
ex.zh: 在阳台种香草已成了我最喜欢的业余爱好。

ex.en: Having a creative hobby can help people manage stress and maintain a healthy balance between work and leisure.
ex.zh: 拥有创造性的业余爱好能帮助人们调节压力，保持工作与休闲之间的健康平衡。

col: take up a hobby｜开始培养一种爱好
a creative hobby｜创造性的业余爱好
pursue a hobby｜从事业余爱好
tip: 可数名词，复数为hobbies；开始一种爱好用take up。

senses.en: the qualities that shape how someone thinks, feels, and behaves
lively or appealing qualities that make someone interesting
a well-known person, especially in entertainment or broadcasting

ex.en: Her cheerful personality makes everyone feel welcome at dinner.
ex.zh: 她开朗的性格让每位来吃饭的人都感到受欢迎。

ex.en: Schools should recognise that differences in personality can influence how students participate in group activities.
ex.zh: 学校应认识到，性格差异会影响学生参与集体活动的方式。

tip: 指性格时可数；have personality指有个人魅力。

senses.en: the skill or power needed to do something

ex.en: Her ability to fix bicycles impressed all her friends.
ex.zh: 她修自行车的本领让朋友们都很佩服。

ex.en: Regular reading can strengthen children's ability to understand complex ideas and express their own views clearly.
ex.zh: 经常阅读可以增强儿童理解复杂概念和清晰表达自身观点的能力。

col: the ability to learn｜学习能力
develop an ability｜培养一种能力
tip: 表示“做某事的能力”用ability to do。

senses.en: relaxed and not easily upset or worried

ex.en: Our easy-going neighbour never complains when our dog barks.
ex.zh: 我们随和的邻居从不因我们的狗叫而抱怨。

ex.en: Although an easy-going management style can reduce workplace stress, clear expectations remain essential for maintaining productivity.
ex.zh: 虽然随和的管理风格能减轻职场压力，但明确的要求对保持生产力仍然至关重要。

tip: 形容性格随和、不易生气，不表示懒惰。

senses.en: Agree to receive something or say yes to an offer
Recognize that something is true or valid
Take responsibility or stop resisting an unpleasant situation

ex.en: I gladly accepted her invitation to dinner on Saturday.
ex.zh: 我欣然接受了她周六共进晚餐的邀请。

ex.en: Governments must accept responsibility for ensuring that all children have access to basic education.
ex.zh: 政府必须承担责任，确保所有儿童都能接受基础教育。

tip: 接受建议用accept；接受某物不等于仅仅收到receive。

senses.en: a male peafowl with long, colourful feathers it spreads out

ex.en: The peacock spread its brilliant feathers beside the pond.
ex.zh: 那只雄孔雀在池塘边展开了鲜艳的羽毛。

ex.en: The elaborate display of a peacock illustrates how mate selection can influence the evolution of animal appearance.
ex.zh: 雄孔雀华丽的开屏展示说明，配偶选择能够影响动物外形的进化。

col: a peacock's tail｜雄孔雀的尾羽
as proud as a peacock｜像孔雀般得意
tip: 严格说peacock指雄孔雀，雌孔雀叫peahen。

senses.en: Showing good judgment based on knowledge and experience.

ex.en: Taking a warm coat was a wise decision today.
ex.zh: 今天带上一件暖和的外套是个明智的决定。

ex.en: It would be wise for governments to invest in preventive healthcare rather than rely solely on hospital treatment.
ex.zh: 政府投资预防性医疗，而非仅仅依靠医院治疗，会是明智之举。

col: wise to do something｜做某事是明智的
tip: wise强调判断明智；clever更强调聪明、学得快。

senses.en: a small brown bird famous for singing sweetly at night

ex.en: We hear a little nightingale singing in the tree near our house.
ex.zh: 我们听到一只小夜莺在屋旁的树上唱歌。

ex.en: In the forest story, the emperor loves listening to the sweet song of the small nightingale.
ex.zh: 在森林故事里，皇帝很喜欢听那只小夜莺动听的歌声。

col: a singing nightingale｜一只唱歌的夜莺
tip: 词首night是“夜晚”，说明夜莺常在夜间歌唱，注意gh不发音。

senses.en: not having, using, or being accompanied by someone or something
not doing the action mentioned

ex.en: I left the house without my keys this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我出门时没带钥匙。

ex.en: Cities cannot achieve lasting reductions in air pollution without investing in reliable public transport.
ex.zh: 如果不投资可靠的公共交通，城市就无法持久地减少空气污染。

col: without saying a word｜一言不发地
tip: without 是介词，后接名词、代词或动词-ing。

senses.en: A feeling of uncertainty about whether something is true or possible.
To feel uncertain about something or think it unlikely.

ex.en: I doubt the shop is still open this late.
ex.zh: 这么晚了，我觉得那家店大概已经关门了。

ex.en: There is little doubt that access to clean water is essential for improving public health.
ex.zh: 毫无疑问，获得清洁用水对于改善公共卫生至关重要。

tip: b不发音；I doubt that常表示认为某事不大可能。

senses.en: To make sounds showing amusement or happiness.
The sound or act of expressing amusement.

ex.en: The baby's funny dance made everyone laugh at dinner.
ex.zh: 宝宝滑稽的舞蹈让吃晚饭的每个人都笑了。

ex.en: People who laugh together regularly may develop stronger social bonds and cope better with everyday stress.
ex.zh: 经常一起欢笑的人可能建立更牢固的社会联系，并更好地应对日常压力。

col: laugh at a joke｜听了笑话发笑
tip: laugh at人常指嘲笑；laugh with人指一起笑。

senses.en: to make fun of someone in an unkind way

ex.en: Good friends never laugh at each other when someone makes a mistake.
ex.zh: 当有人犯错时，好朋友从不互相嘲笑。

ex.en: Our teacher tells us not to laugh at classmates who feel shy when speaking English.
ex.zh: 老师告诉我们不要嘲笑在说英语时感到害羞的同学。

col: laugh at a mistake｜嘲笑错误
tip: at后面常接人或事物，记住要友善待人，不要嘲笑别人。

senses.en: To raise the corners of your mouth, showing happiness or friendliness.
A facial expression with raised mouth corners, often showing happiness.

ex.en: The baby smiled when I waved across the room.
ex.zh: 我在房间另一头挥手时，宝宝笑了。

ex.en: A friendly smile can help patients feel more comfortable when discussing their concerns with healthcare professionals.
ex.zh: 友善的微笑能让患者在与医护人员讨论自己的顾虑时感到更自在。

tip: 对某人微笑用smile at，不用smile to。

senses.en: One of the light, soft structures covering a bird's body.

ex.en: A white feather floated gently onto the garden path.
ex.zh: 一根白色羽毛轻轻飘落在花园小径上。

ex.en: Feathers help birds maintain their body temperature, allowing them to survive in colder environments.
ex.zh: 羽毛帮助鸟类维持体温，使它们能在较寒冷的环境中生存。

col: as light as a feather｜轻如鸿毛
tip: feather指单根羽毛；fur通常指动物浓密的毛。

senses.zh: 颜色鲜艳的；五彩缤纷的
色彩鲜艳的；五彩缤纷的
senses.en: Having many bright colours

senses.zh: 生动有趣的；丰富多彩的
senses.en: Full of interesting, unusual or exciting details

ex.en: Colourful balloons floated above the tables at the party.
ex.zh: 聚会上，五彩缤纷的气球飘浮在桌子上方。

ex.en: Colourful public murals can transform neglected urban spaces and encourage residents to take pride in their neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 色彩鲜艳的公共壁画能改变被忽视的城市空间，增强居民对社区的自豪感。

col: a colourful character｜有趣独特的人物
a colourful history｜丰富多彩的历史
tip: 英式拼写colourful，美式拼写colorful。

senses.en: The time ahead, or what will happen to someone or something.
Happening or existing at a time after the present.

ex.en: We talked about our future while walking home.
ex.zh: 我们走路回家时聊了聊我们的未来。

ex.en: Governments should invest in renewable energy to protect the environment for future generations worldwide.
ex.zh: 各国政府应投资可再生能源，为世界各地的子孙后代保护环境。

tip: in the future指将来；英式in future常指从今以后。

senses.en: To touch gently several times with a flat hand.
A gentle touch made with a flat hand.

ex.en: She patted the dog gently as it fell asleep.
ex.zh: 狗渐渐睡着时，她轻轻地拍抚着它。

ex.en: A gentle pat on the shoulder can offer reassurance, although attitudes towards physical contact vary across cultures.
ex.zh: 轻拍肩膀可以让人安心，不过不同文化对身体接触的态度有所不同。

col: pat someone on the back｜轻拍某人的背
give someone a pat｜轻拍某人
tip: 过去式patted、现在分词patting均双写t。

senses.en: an ability to do something well, developed through practice

ex.en: Baking good bread takes patience and a little skill.
ex.zh: 烤出好面包需要耐心和一点技巧。

ex.en: Schools should teach practical skills that help young people manage money and communicate effectively.
ex.zh: 学校应教授实用技能，帮助年轻人管理金钱并进行有效沟通。

col: develop a skill｜培养一项技能
skill in doing something｜做某事的技巧
tip: 具体技能可数；泛指熟练程度时常不可数。

senses.en: Unlike anything else, or the only one of its kind
Found only in a particular person, place, or thing

ex.en: Each handmade bowl has a unique pattern inside.
ex.zh: 每个手工碗的内侧都有独特的图案。

ex.en: Protecting local crafts helps communities preserve their unique cultural identity in an increasingly globalised world.
ex.zh: 在日益全球化的世界中，保护地方手工艺有助于社区保留独特的文化认同。

col: unique to the region｜该地区特有的
tip: unique to表示某处特有；严格指唯一时不用very修饰。

senses.en: to express or stand for a particular idea or sense

ex.en: What does this new English word mean in our textbook today?
ex.zh: 今天我们课本里的这个新英语单词是什么意思？

ex.en: In traffic safety lessons, we learn that a red light means every car must stop.
ex.zh: 在交通安全课上，我们学到红灯的意思是每辆车都必须停下。

col: What does it mean?｜它是什么意思？
tip: 询问词义常用“... mean?”，过去式是不规则变化meant。

senses.en: A board displaying announcements for people to read.

ex.en: Someone pinned a lost cat poster to the noticeboard.
ex.zh: 有人把寻猫启事钉在了布告栏上。

ex.en: A shared noticeboard can help residents discover local events and participate more actively in community life.
ex.zh: 共用布告栏可以帮助居民了解当地活动，更积极地参与社区生活。

col: put up a noticeboard｜安装布告栏
tip: 英式常用noticeboard，美式常用bulletin board。

senses.zh: （客气地 建议或邀请）将；将会
senses.en: used to make a polite offer, invitation, or suggestion

ex.en: Would you like to drink a glass of warm milk now?
ex.zh: 你现在想喝一杯温牛奶吗？

ex.en: Would you like to join our science club and learn about stars together?
ex.zh: 你愿意加入我们的科学社团，一起学习星星的知识吗？

tip: 表示客气邀请或建议时，常用于“Would you like...?”句型。

senses.en: an instruction stating what is allowed or required
control of a country or people by a leader or group
to govern a country or make an official legal decision

ex.en: Our main rule is to leave muddy shoes outside.
ex.zh: 我们最主要的规矩是把沾泥的鞋子留在外面。

ex.en: Clear rules on industrial waste disposal are essential for protecting rivers and ensuring safe drinking water.
ex.zh: 关于工业废物处理的明确规定对于保护河流和保障饮用水安全至关重要。

tip: as a rule意为“通常”；rule out意为“排除”。

senses.en: a railway system built in tunnels below the ground

ex.en: My father takes the underground to his office every morning.
ex.zh: 我爸爸每天早上坐地铁去他的办公室。

ex.en: Shenzhen has a fast underground system that helps millions of people travel across the city.
ex.zh: 深圳有快速的地铁系统，帮助数百万人穿梭城市各地。

tip: 由under和ground合成，“坐地铁”用by underground。

senses.en: Bend or rest against something in a sloping position.
Having little body fat or containing little fat.
Using few resources while avoiding waste.

ex.en: She leaned against the wall and untied her shoes.
ex.zh: 她靠着墙，解开了鞋带。

ex.en: Lean production methods can help manufacturers reduce waste while maintaining the quality of their products.
ex.zh: 精益生产方法能帮助制造商在保持产品质量的同时减少浪费。

tip: lean against指倚靠；lean towards可指倾向于。

senses.en: Waste left scattered in public places.
To leave rubbish or other objects scattered across a place.
A group of young animals born to one mother together.

ex.en: We picked up litter along the beach before lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭前，我们沿着海滩捡垃圾。

ex.en: Reducing litter in urban parks requires convenient bins as well as sustained public education campaigns.
ex.zh: 减少城市公园里乱扔的垃圾，需要设置便于使用的垃圾桶，并持续开展公众教育活动。

col: a litter of puppies｜一窝小狗
tip: 垃圾义不可数；一窝幼崽用a litter of。

senses.en: An empty space between things or within something.
A difference between people, groups, or situations.
A period when something stops or does not happen.

ex.en: The kitten squeezed through a gap in the fence.
ex.zh: 小猫从篱笆的一个缺口钻了过去。

ex.en: Improving access to affordable education could narrow the gap between wealthy households and disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 让更多人获得负担得起的教育，可以缩小富裕家庭与弱势社区之间的差距。

col: a gap in the fence｜篱笆上的缺口
tip: 两者间的差距用 gap between A and B。

senses.en: In addition to or different from someone or something mentioned
Used after or to introduce an alternative or consequence

ex.en: Would you like anything else with your soup?
ex.zh: 除了汤，你还想要点别的吗？

ex.en: Governments must improve public transport, or else growing traffic congestion may undermine the economic benefits of urban development.
ex.zh: 政府必须改善公共交通，否则日益严重的交通拥堵可能削弱城市发展带来的经济效益。

tip: 放在不定代词或疑问词后，如someone else。

senses.en: moving stairs that carry people between floors

ex.en: Hold the handrail while you ride the escalator upstairs.
ex.zh: 乘自动扶梯上楼时，请扶好扶手。

ex.en: Although escalators improve passenger flow in stations, lifts are essential for travellers who use wheelchairs.
ex.zh: 尽管自动扶梯能改善车站的客流通行情况，但对使用轮椅的旅客而言，电梯必不可少。

col: an upward escalator｜上行自动扶梯
tip: escalator是自动扶梯；lift是厢式电梯。

senses.en: A place where trains or buses stop for passengers.
A place or organisation providing a particular service.
To place someone somewhere to perform a duty.

ex.en: We hurried to the station with our heavy suitcases.
ex.zh: 我们提着沉重的行李箱匆忙赶往车站。

ex.en: Local authorities should station trained staff at busy transport hubs to assist passengers with limited mobility.
ex.zh: 地方政府应在繁忙的交通枢纽安排受过培训的工作人员，帮助行动不便的乘客。

tip: 作动词常用被动式be stationed at，表示被派驻。

senses.en: a public statement giving people information or news

ex.en: We heard an announcement about our train being delayed.
ex.zh: 我们听到了一则关于所乘列车晚点的通知。

ex.en: The government's announcement of additional education funding was welcomed by teachers and parents.
ex.zh: 政府宣布追加教育经费，受到教师和家长的欢迎。

tip: 表示发布公告时用make an announcement。

senses.en: Someone travelling in a vehicle without driving or operating it

ex.en: A passenger left a blue umbrella on the bus.
ex.zh: 一位乘客把一把蓝色雨伞落在了公交车上。

ex.en: Improved rail services could increase passenger numbers and reduce reliance on private cars.
ex.zh: 改善铁路服务可以增加乘客数量，减少人们对私家车的依赖。

tip: 指乘坐交通工具的人，不包括驾驶员或机组人员。

senses.en: a machine that carries people or things up and down in a building

ex.en: Let us take the lift to the fifth floor together.
ex.zh: 我们一起坐电梯去五楼吧。

ex.en: In tall city buildings, people use the lift to go up quickly without getting tired.
ex.zh: 在城市的高楼里，人们乘电梯快速上楼而不会觉得累。

tip: 作名词指“电梯”多用于英式英语，注意区分动词“抬起”的意思。

senses.en: The area beside railway tracks where passengers board trains.
A raised surface where people can stand or perform.
A service or system for sharing information or doing activities.

ex.en: We waited on the platform as the train approached.
ex.zh: 火车驶近时，我们正在站台上等候。

ex.en: Online learning platforms allow students in remote areas to access courses that are unavailable locally.
ex.zh: 在线学习平台让偏远地区的学生能够学习当地没有开设的课程。

col: a platform for debate｜辩论的平台
tip: 在站台上用on the platform，不用in。

senses.en: a long, thin mark on a surface
people or things arranged one behind or beside another
a route or connection for transport or communication

ex.en: Draw a straight line across the page with your ruler.
ex.zh: 用尺子在纸上画一条直线。

ex.en: Extending the railway line could connect rural communities with employment opportunities in nearby cities.
ex.zh: 延长铁路线可以让农村社区的居民获得附近城市的就业机会。

tip: 排队在美式英语中常用stand in line，英式常用queue。

senses.en: to move or do something very quickly, often without care
a state of hurry or a period of intense activity
a sudden strong feeling or flow of something

ex.en: I rushed downstairs when I heard the doorbell.
ex.zh: 听到门铃声，我赶紧跑下了楼。

ex.en: Governments should not rush major transport projects without first assessing their environmental and financial impacts.
ex.zh: 政府不应在评估环境和财务影响之前仓促推进重大交通项目。

col: rush into a decision｜仓促作决定
a rush of excitement｜一阵兴奋
tip: rush to do表示赶紧做；rush into表示仓促行动。

senses.en: to breathe in and blow out smoke from a cigarette

ex.en: People must not smoke inside the hospital or the library.
ex.zh: 人们禁止在医院或图书馆里面吸烟。

ex.en: Signs in parks remind visitors not to smoke so everyone can enjoy clean, fresh air.
ex.zh: 公园里的标志提醒游客不要吸烟，让大家享受清新空气。

col: not smoke here｜不要在这里吸烟
tip: 常见标志“No smoking!”表示禁止吸烟，变为ing形式时要去e。

senses.en: A place or object for someone to sit on.
To provide a sitting place or have room for seated people.
A position as a member of an elected body.

ex.en: She saved me a seat near the front.
ex.zh: 她在靠前的位置给我留了一个座位。

ex.en: Providing more seats on public transport would make daily travel easier for older passengers and families.
ex.zh: 在公共交通工具上增加座位，会让老年乘客和家庭的日常出行更方便。

tip: sit是不及物动词；seat常接人，be seated表就座。

senses.en: any person, without restriction
a person, used in questions and negative statements

ex.en: Anyone can join our weekend walk by the river.
ex.zh: 任何人都可以参加我们周末的河边散步活动。

ex.en: Public libraries should provide free internet access to anyone who needs it, regardless of income.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆应向任何有需要的人免费提供互联网服务，不论其收入如何。

tip: 作主语时谓语用单数；any one强调任意一个。

senses.en: To go away from a person or place.
To let something remain somewhere, deliberately or accidentally.
An officially allowed period away from work.

ex.en: We need to leave before the traffic gets worse.
ex.zh: 我们得在交通变得更拥堵之前出发。

ex.en: Paid parental leave allows new parents to care for their children without immediately returning to work.
ex.zh: 带薪育儿假让新手父母能够照顾孩子，而不必立即重返工作岗位。

tip: leave 的过去式和过去分词均为 left。

senses.en: Things people throw away because they no longer need them.
Ideas or statements that are silly or untrue.

ex.en: Please put your rubbish in the bin outside.
ex.zh: 请把垃圾放进外面的垃圾桶。

ex.en: Reducing household rubbish requires both convenient recycling facilities and greater public awareness of unnecessary packaging.
ex.zh: 减少生活垃圾既需要便利的回收设施，也需要提高公众对过度包装的认识。

tip: 通常不可数；英式常用词，美式常说garbage或trash。

senses.en: A hand covering with separate sections for fingers and thumb.

ex.en: I found my missing glove under the kitchen chair.
ex.zh: 我在厨房椅子下面找到了丢失的那只手套。

ex.en: Healthcare workers should change disposable gloves between patients to reduce the risk of spreading infections.
ex.zh: 医护人员在接诊不同患者之间应更换一次性手套，以降低传播感染的风险。

col: a pair of gloves｜一副手套
tip: 一副手套用 a pair of gloves，注意 gloves 用复数。

senses.en: Damaged by being split or separated into pieces.
Not working properly because of damage.
Spoken with difficulty and frequent pauses or errors.

ex.en: She carefully swept the broken glass into a dustpan.
ex.zh: 她小心地把碎玻璃扫进簸箕里。

ex.en: Repairing broken household appliances rather than replacing them can reduce waste and conserve valuable natural resources.
ex.zh: 维修损坏的家用电器而非更换它们，可以减少废弃物并节约宝贵的自然资源。

col: a broken promise｜未兑现的承诺
tip: 也是break的过去分词；过去式为broke。

senses.en: an object used to hold or store things
a large metal box used to transport goods

ex.en: Keep the leftover rice in a container with a lid.
ex.zh: 把剩米饭放在有盖的容器里。

ex.en: Reusable food containers can reduce household waste when people use them instead of disposable packaging.
ex.zh: 人们用可重复使用的食品容器代替一次性包装，可以减少家庭垃圾。

tip: 泛指盛装东西的容器；运输语境常指集装箱。

senses.en: Prepared or available for use or action.
Willing to do something.
About to do something very soon.

ex.en: Dinner is ready, so please bring your plate.
ex.zh: 晚饭好了，请把你的盘子拿来。

ex.en: Schools must ensure that students are ready to meet the demands of a rapidly changing workplace.
ex.zh: 学校必须确保学生做好准备，以应对快速变化的职场需求。

col: ready and willing｜乐意且准备好
tip: ready for后接名词；ready to后接动词原形。

senses.en: To move behind someone or along a route.
To act according to instructions, rules, or advice.
To understand what someone says or explains.

ex.en: Follow this path until you reach the wooden bridge.
ex.zh: 沿着这条小路走，直到到达木桥。

ex.en: Schools should teach children how to follow safety guidelines when using digital devices and online services.
ex.zh: 学校应教导儿童在使用数字设备和网络服务时如何遵守安全准则。

col: follow an argument｜理解论证思路
tip: follow直接接宾语：follow me，不加with。

senses.en: to continue to be in a particular state or condition

ex.en: We should eat fresh fruit every day to stay healthy.
ex.zh: 我们应该每天吃新鲜水果来保持健康。

ex.en: Doing morning exercise and drinking enough water help students stay strong during the school year.
ex.zh: 做早操和喝足够的水能帮助学生在新学年里保持强壮。

tip: 作连系动词表示“保持”，后接形容词，如stay healthy。

senses.zh: 逐渐变得；逐渐 成为
senses.en: to slowly change and become different over time

ex.en: The sky begins to grow dark before a heavy rain.
ex.zh: 大雨来临前，天空开始逐渐变暗。

ex.en: As autumn arrives in the north, the days grow shorter and the air feels cooler.
ex.zh: 随着北方秋天到来，白天逐渐变短，空气也感觉更凉爽。

tip: 表示“逐渐变得”时后接形容词，过去式是grew，注意与“种植”区分。

senses.en: Having great value or a significant effect.
Having considerable power, influence, or status.

ex.en: Keep your important documents in this waterproof folder.
ex.zh: 把你的重要文件放在这个防水文件夹里。

ex.en: Access to reliable information plays an important role in helping citizens make informed decisions about their health.
ex.zh: 获取可靠信息对于帮助公民作出明智的健康决策起着重要作用。

col: important to someone｜对某人很重要
tip: 用It is important to do；importance是名词形式。

senses.en: to do something one after another in a fair order

ex.en: My brother and I take turns to wash the dishes.
ex.zh: 我和弟弟轮流洗碗。

ex.en: During the science experiment, students take turns looking through the microscope to observe tiny leaves.
ex.zh: 在科学实验课上，同学们轮流通过显微镜观察小树叶。

col: take turns to do｜轮流做某事
tip: turns要用复数形式，后面可接to do或动词-ing，表示公平轮流。

senses.en: Used to express happiness, excitement, or approval.

ex.en: Hurrah, the rain has stopped and we can play outside!
ex.zh: 好哇，雨停了，我们可以出去玩了！

ex.en: The volunteers shouted hurrah when they learned that their campaign had saved the local park.
ex.zh: 得知他们的行动保住了当地公园，志愿者们高声欢呼。

col: a final hurrah｜最后一次精彩表现
tip: 与hooray意思相同；常独立使用，后接感叹号。

senses.en: a representation showing how something looks, works, or is organised
someone or something that provides a good example to follow
a person who displays clothes or poses for artists

ex.en: He built a model of a bridge from cardboard.
ex.zh: 他用硬纸板做了一座桥的模型。

ex.en: Researchers use a computer model to predict how rising temperatures may affect regional water supplies.
ex.zh: 研究人员利用计算机模型预测气温上升可能如何影响区域供水。

tip: model还可作动词，表示建模或当模特。

senses.zh: （与某些名词结合使 用，表示将要做或将付出某事物）
senses.en: used with certain nouns to mean giving attention, visits, or respect

ex.en: Please pay close attention when the teacher explains the rules.
ex.zh: 老师讲解规则时，请大家密切注意。

ex.en: Our class will pay a visit to the Shenzhen Museum to learn about local history.
ex.zh: 我们班将去参观深圳博物馆，了解当地的历史。

tip: 这里不指付钱，常与attention、visit等名词搭配，过去式paid。

senses.en: The act of focusing your mind on someone or something.
Care or action given to someone or something that needs it.

ex.en: Please pay attention while I explain the game.
ex.zh: 我讲解游戏规则时，请认真听。

ex.en: Schools should give greater attention to students' emotional wellbeing alongside their academic progress.
ex.zh: 学校在关注学生学业进展的同时，也应更加重视他们的情绪健康。

tip: pay attention to后接名词或动名词，to是介词。

senses.en: to watch, listen to, or think about someone or something carefully

ex.en: You must pay attention to the traffic lights before crossing.
ex.zh: 过马路前你一定要注意红绿灯。

ex.en: Students should pay attention to their spelling when writing short stories in English class.
ex.zh: 学生在英语课写短篇故事时应该注意自己的拼写。

col: pay attention to safety｜注意安全
pay attention to details｜注意细节
pay close attention to｜密切注意
tip: to是介词，后面可以接名词、代词或动词-ing形式，表示专注某事。

senses.en: images, feelings, and events experienced while sleeping
something you strongly hope to achieve or experience
to experience dreams while sleeping or imagine something you want

ex.en: Last night, I had a dream about flying over mountains.
ex.zh: 昨晚我做了一个飞越群山的梦。

ex.en: Access to affordable education allows more young people to pursue their dream of entering a skilled profession.
ex.zh: 负担得起的教育让更多年轻人能够追求从事技术性职业的梦想。

col: a dream come true｜梦想成真
tip: dream of/about后接名词或动名词；过去式可用dreamt或dreamed。

senses.zh: （集体）出外游 玩（或学习）；远足
senses.en: a short trip taken by a group of people for fun or learning

ex.en: Our class is planning a fun spring outing this Friday.
ex.zh: 我们班计划这周五去一次有趣的春游。

ex.en: During our autumn outing in the forest park, we learned the names of many plants.
ex.zh: 在森林公园的秋游中，我们认识了许多植物的名字。

tip: 首音为元音，说“一次郊游”要用an outing，常见搭配spring outing。

senses.en: A movable barrier controlling entry through a fence or wall.
An airport area where passengers board a plane.

ex.en: She closed the garden gate to keep the dog inside.
ex.zh: 她关上花园的门，免得狗跑出去。

ex.en: Airports should provide clear directions so passengers can reach their departure gate without unnecessary stress.
ex.zh: 机场应提供清晰的指引，让乘客无需过度紧张就能找到登机口。

tip: gate多指围墙或栅栏上的门；房间的门通常用door。

senses.en: A special occasion when people celebrate a tradition or event
An organised series of performances or other cultural events

ex.en: Our town holds a lantern festival every autumn.
ex.zh: 我们镇每年秋天都会举办灯会。

ex.en: An annual arts festival can attract visitors while providing local performers with valuable opportunities to reach wider audiences.
ex.zh: 一年一度的艺术节既能吸引游客，也能为当地表演者提供接触更多观众的宝贵机会。

col: hold a festival｜举办节庆活动
tip: festival强调庆祝或系列活动，不一定是放假的holiday。

senses.en: From one side of something to the other.
On the opposite side of, or throughout, an area.

senses.zh: 从一边到另一边；在对面
senses.en: From one side to another, or on the opposite side.

ex.en: We walked across the bridge before the rain started.
ex.zh: 下雨前，我们走过了那座桥。

ex.en: Improved internet access allows students across rural regions to benefit from a wider range of educational resources.
ex.zh: 互联网接入条件的改善，让广大农村地区的学生能够利用更丰富的教育资源。

tip: across强调横跨表面；through强调从内部穿过。

senses.en: the shared beliefs, customs and ways of life of a group
activities involving art, music, literature and other creative work
cells or microorganisms grown under controlled conditions

ex.en: Sharing traditional meals helps children learn about their culture.
ex.zh: 分享传统餐食有助于孩子了解自己的文化。

ex.en: Preserving local culture can strengthen community identity while allowing residents to benefit from international exchange.
ex.zh: 保护本土文化可以增强社区认同，同时让居民受益于国际交流。

tip: 泛指文化通常不可数；不同文化可用cultures。

senses.en: good or bad things that happen to you by chance

ex.en: Good luck to you in the school singing contest today!
ex.zh: 祝你今天在学校歌唱比赛中好运！

ex.en: In Chinese culture, red envelopes and lanterns are popular symbols of good luck and joy.
ex.zh: 在中国文化中，红包和灯笼是象征好运与喜悦的流行符号。

tip: luck是不可数名词，不能加a或s，形容词形式是lucky（幸运的）。

senses.en: a traditional Chinese snack made of vegetables or meat rolled in thin pastry

ex.en: My grandma makes delicious spring rolls for us every weekend.
ex.zh: 奶奶每个周末都会给我们做美味的春卷。

ex.en: During the Spring Festival, many Chinese families enjoy eating crispy golden spring rolls together.
ex.zh: 春节期间，许多中国家庭会一起享用酥脆金黄的春卷。

col: eat a spring roll｜吃一个春卷
tip: spring roll是可数名词，复数直接加s；因为是春季传统美食而得名。

senses.en: A thick breakfast dish made by cooking oats in liquid.

ex.en: I topped my warm porridge with sliced banana.
ex.zh: 我在热燕麦粥上放了些香蕉片。

ex.en: Schools can offer porridge at breakfast to provide pupils with an affordable and nutritious meal.
ex.zh: 学校可以在早餐时提供燕麦粥，让学生吃上价格实惠、营养丰富的一餐。

col: a bowl of porridge｜一碗燕麦粥
tip: 通常为不可数名词；一碗用a bowl of。

senses.zh: 有好运的；运气好的；幸运的

senses.en: Having good things happen by chance.
Believed to bring good fortune.

ex.en: We were lucky to catch the last bus home.
ex.zh: 我们很幸运，赶上了回家的末班公交车。

ex.en: Although some entrepreneurs benefit from lucky opportunities, long-term business success usually requires careful planning and consistent effort.
ex.zh: 虽然一些创业者受益于偶然的机遇，但企业的长期成功通常需要周密规划和持续努力。

col: a lucky break｜好运带来的机会
tip: “有幸做某事”用be lucky to do something。

senses.zh: （在计算机屏幕上 用鼠标）点击，单击

senses.en: to press a mouse button or select something on screen
a short sharp sound, or an action selecting something onscreen
to suddenly become clear or understood

ex.en: Click on the picture to see a larger version.
ex.zh: 点击图片即可查看大图。

ex.en: Students should check whether a website is trustworthy before they click on links or share personal information.
ex.zh: 学生在点击链接或分享个人信息前，应检查网站是否可信。

col: click on a link｜点击链接
a mouse click｜一次鼠标点击
a sharp click｜清脆的咔嗒声
tip: 点击链接常用click on；it clicked可指突然想通了。

senses.zh: 节日或重大事件的前夕
senses.en: The day or evening before a special day or event.
The first woman in the biblical account of creation.

ex.en: We cooked a special dinner together on New Year's Eve.
ex.zh: 我们在除夕夜一起做了一顿特别的晚餐。

ex.en: On New Year's Eve, cities often extend public transport services to help large crowds travel home safely.
ex.zh: 在除夕夜，城市往往延长公共交通的运营时间，帮助大批人群安全返家。

tip: 普通名词eve通常小写；节日名称中大写，Eve也指夏娃。

senses.en: A belief or custom passed down through generations.

ex.en: Making dumplings together is a tradition in our family.
ex.zh: 一起包饺子是我们家的传统。

ex.en: Schools can help preserve local traditions by inviting older residents to share their knowledge and practical skills.
ex.zh: 学校可以邀请年长居民分享知识和实用技能，从而帮助保留当地传统。

tip: 具体习俗可数；泛指传统时可不可数，如break with tradition。

senses.en: An area of land governed as an independent political unit.
Land outside towns and cities, often with farms and villages.
A popular music style rooted in rural American traditions.

ex.en: She hopes to visit another country next summer.
ex.zh: 她希望明年夏天去另一个国家旅行。

ex.en: Each country should develop energy policies that reflect its natural resources and long-term environmental goals.
ex.zh: 各国都应根据本国自然资源和长期环境目标制定能源政策。

col: live in the country｜住在乡下
tip: 表示“乡下”常用 the country，与国家义区分。

senses.en: a large amount of money and valuable possessions
a large supply of something useful or valuable

ex.en: His wealth allowed him to buy a spacious house.
ex.zh: 他的财富使他能够买下一栋宽敞的房子。

ex.en: A fairer distribution of wealth could improve access to education and reduce inequality across society.
ex.zh: 更公平地分配财富可以改善受教育机会，并减少社会不平等。

col: a wealth of experience｜丰富的经验
tip: wealth通常不可数；a wealth of表示大量有价值的事物。

senses.zh: 希望；期望（某事 发生）

senses.en: to want something to happen and believe it may happen
a feeling that something wanted may happen

ex.en: I hope the rain stops before our picnic.
ex.zh: 我希望野餐前雨能停。

ex.en: Many graduates hope to find meaningful employment that allows them to contribute positively to society.
ex.zh: 许多毕业生希望找到有意义的工作，使自己能够为社会作出积极贡献。

col: hope to do something｜希望做某事
hope for the best｜抱最好的希望
in the hope of｜怀着……的希望
tip: 可说hope to do，不说hope sb to do。

senses.en: to give or hand something to another person

ex.en: Could you please pass me the salt on the table?
ex.zh: 你能把桌上的盐递给我吗？

ex.en: The basketball players quickly pass the ball to their teammates to score another point.
ex.zh: 篮球运动员们迅速把球传给队友，再得一分。

col: pass me a pen｜递给我一支笔
tip: 常用pass sb. sth.或pass sth. to sb.表示“把某物递给某人”。

senses.zh: 传递；转交；（用后）递给， 传给
senses.en: to give something you received or used to the next person

ex.en: Please read this note and pass it on to Lily.
ex.zh: 请读完这张便条，然后把它转交给莉莉。

ex.en: In our nature club, older students pass on their used science books to younger classmates.
ex.zh: 在自然社团里，高年级学生会把用过的科学书传给低年级同学。

tip: 接代词it或them时，要放在pass和on中间，说pass it on。

senses.en: Twelve o'clock at night, when one day ends and another begins.

ex.en: We stayed awake until midnight watching the snow fall.
ex.zh: 我们一直醒着看雪，直到午夜。

ex.en: Extending public transport services beyond midnight would benefit shift workers who currently rely on expensive taxi journeys.
ex.zh: 将公共交通服务延长至午夜之后，将有利于目前依赖昂贵出租车出行的轮班工作者。

tip: 在午夜用at midnight，不用in midnight。

senses.en: Involving two or more countries.
A match between countries, or a player representing a country.

ex.en: My sister is taking an international flight tomorrow morning.
ex.zh: 我姐姐明天早上要乘坐国际航班。

ex.en: International cooperation is essential for tackling environmental problems that extend beyond the borders of individual countries.
ex.zh: 国际合作对于解决超越单个国家边界的环境问题至关重要。

tip: international涉及多国；domestic指国内的。
